format: UCWDC Teams, gender and Team Couple roles

source.quote_free_summary: A Team may compete with any number and combination of genders.

requirement: A future UCWDC Teams profile must accept any gender combination in a Team.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: gender collection, columns, migrations, role-lock enforcement, UI.
interpretation_notes: Permission only (II.C.1). Studio collects no gender, so nothing in Studio restricts team composition. The Team Couple role rule is the separate mandatory entry OD27-UCWDC-0006.
decision_refs: OD-27 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B retain Studio/Custom role flexibility; document body limitations; retrospective audit PR #795)
